neighbours.label: a roll or test that decides an outcome in a game or trial (a Stealth roll, a test of courage)
fire: Make a Wisdom + Empathy roll as a free action.
Any time you lose a fight, take a Willpower Test at once.
The knight had to pass a test of courage and honor.
Fast units add +2 to morale test rolls.
The defender gets one saving throw against the spell.
Each player makes a Strength roll before crossing the bridge.
The bill passed subject to a vote of the members.
To enter the guild, she must face a trial of wits.
quiet: Move your piece two squares as a free action.
Any time you lose a fight, return the card to the deck.
The knight had to ride all night to reach the castle.
Fast units cost two more coins than slow ones.
The defender sits behind a wall on the left side of the board.
Each player draws a card before crossing the bridge.
The bill was printed on green paper for the members.
To enter the guild, she walked along a narrow alley.

short: a roll or test deciding an outcome
notes: Everyday 'math test' and 'the vote was held' scored about 0.2 in the probes, so some ordinary uses fire weakly.
